t: how well do 4x4 quads work on sand dunes
s: When stopping at the dealers I get responses anywhere from "don't use anything but a sport quad on sand dunes" to "don't use anything but a 4x4 on sand dunes"... I ride a Banshee in the dunes all the time and get up everything I come across with paddles and most stuff with knobbies. By the same token, my '02 F350 goes up pretty much the same dunes in 4wd if I keep the tire pressure low enough. The Banshee goes up the dunes at mach 7. The Super Duty goes up at about mach .00000000000007. Buy what you'd need to get around most of the time.
